findings.text: Each listed header establishes a single include guard macro preventing repeated inclusion within one translation unit. Guard presence carries no runtime contract.

Filtering iteration is provided over child firmware nodes of a device, selecting only nodes advertising controller capability. Supporting helpers expose the count of such nodes and access to the first match, reporting absence with null.

Nibble conversion helpers translate low and high halves of a byte through lower case and upper case digit tables. Byte packing helpers encode one input byte as two printable characters at a caller cursor and return the advanced cursor.
Fallback identities for user, group and filesystem user and group are 65534. They substitute for values that cannot be represented in a narrow field.

Wide to narrow conversion preserves values fitting in sixteen bits and substitutes the configured overflow identity otherwise. Narrow to wide conversion preserves the all ones sentinel and widens other values unchanged. A size aware selector narrows only when the destination cannot hold the source, with an alternate build where conversion is identity. Storage helpers assign the converted result to a caller variable.
Filesystem narrowing mirrors the general overflow rule using filesystem overflow identities. Additional helpers isolate the lower sixteen bits and the upper sixteen bits of a value.
Blocker type codes are mutex 0, semaphore 1, read semaphore reader 2 and read semaphore writer 3. A two bit mask value 3 isolates the type field from a combined blocker value.

The active configuration records the current task blocker as a combination of lock identity and type, clears it to empty, and provides extraction of the type field and the lock identity from a stored value.
The alternate configuration disables blocker tracking so recording and clearing have no effect, type extraction reports zero and lock extraction reports absence.

Recording expects a non null suitably aligned lock and an unset prior blocker, warning on violation and ignoring unsuitable addresses without update. Extraction warns when applied to an empty value. Byte packing needs two writable bytes. Overflow substitution is silent.
Instruction breakpoint type occupies index zero. Data breakpoint type aliases index zero when mixed register support is present and index one otherwise, with a following terminator marking the count.

Attribute preparation initializes a breakpoint description for pinned frequent notification use, with a ptrace variant excluding kernel side activity. Accessors expose address, type, length and architecture state recorded in an event.

Fallback definitions report unavailability for user, wide and perf registration and modification, no active use, no slot allocation and no architecture state, while release, unregister, flush and early init complete without effect.

Hardware random generator descriptor carries identity name, lifecycle callbacks, presence and retrieval operations plus bulk read, private value and quality rating, with list linkage, reference counting and work plus completion state for teardown coordination.

Virtual CPU pinning either delegates to platform handling or does nothing depending on build. Jailhouse presence follows device tree compatibility. Isolated PCI behavior is affirmed on two architectures and otherwise follows Jailhouse presence. The compatibility lookup fallback reports absence.
Maximum bus frequencies are standard 100000, fast 400000, fast plus 1000000, turbo 1400000, high speed 3400000 and ultra fast 5000000 hertz.

Master receive and send helpers perform single read and write transfers of caller specified length. Direct memory access safe variants offer the same contract with an additional buffer suitability guarantee.

Swapped word helpers exchange byte order around the underlying word operation. Read propagates negative status unchanged and swaps successful values, while write swaps the caller value before issuing the underlying write.
Device identity groups manufacturer, part and die revision information for identification commands.
Manufacturer codes are NXP variants 0 through 3, Ramtron 4, Analog Devices 5, ST 6, On Semiconductor 7, Sprintek 8, Espros 9, Fujitsu 10, FLIR 11, O2Micro 12, Atmel 13, and none 65535.
Alert handling distinguishes SMBus alert style from SMBus host notify style as separate protocols.

Driver descriptor carries probe, remove and shutdown behavior, alert and command handling, core driver linkage, identifier table, detection callback with address list, client list linkage, class matching and behavioral flags. A conversion helper derives the containing driver from a generic driver reference.
Driver flag for waiving ACPI D0 probe occupies bit zero.

Client descriptor records addressing flags, chip address, symbolic name, parent adapter linkage, embedded device, initialization and runtime interrupts, detection linkage, optional slave callback, devres grouping and debug location. A conversion helper derives the client from its embedded device.

Client flag values are packet error checking 4, ten bit address 16, slave role 32, host notify 64, wake 128 and SCCB 36864. Ten bit and SCCB values have stated correspondence with message flag combinations.

Helpers translate between kernel object, device and client views and store or retrieve opaque driver private data through the embedded device. Verification of a generic device as a client reports absence in the observed fallback.

Slave mode events enumerate read requested, write requested, read processed, write received and stop as distinct phases of a slave transaction. Slave mode detection reports false in the observed fallback.

Board information aggregates static instantiation details including type, flags, address, device name, platform data, firmware and software node references, resource range and interrupt. A compact initializer supplies type and address. Static registration in the observed fallback reports success without effect.

Algorithm descriptor provides message transfer and atomic transfer operations under dual naming, bus management transfer and atomic transfer operations, a capability query operation, and conditional target registration and unregistration operations also under dual naming.

Bus serialization is expressed through callbacks for blocking lock, attempted lock and unlock with caller flags, complemented by adapter resident mutexes for bus and multiplexing paths plus a mutex guarding user space client membership.
Timing descriptor collects bus frequency together with rise, fall, internal delay, hold, digital filter and analog filter characteristics.

Bus recovery descriptor offers full bus recovery plus line sensing and driving for clock and data, bus free assessment and preparation hooks, with optional gpio descriptors and pin control states for default and gpio modes.
Quirk descriptor limits capability flags, message count and length bounds for write, read and combined phases.

Quirk bits are combined support bit 0, write first bit 1, read second bit 2, same address bit 3, no clock stretch bit 4, no zero read bit 5, no zero write bit 6 and no repeated start bit 7, with combined write then read and combined zero length shorthands joining the relevant bits.

Adapter descriptor joins owner, class, algorithm and algorithm data, lock operations, timeout and retry policy, embedded device, ownership flags, number, symbolic name, release completion, recovery info, quirks, host notify domain, regulator, debug location and a bitmap tracking addresses under instantiation. Helpers convert from device and store opaque adapter data.
Adapter ownership flag positions are suspended bit 0 and suspend reported bit 1.
Parent lookup returns the containing adapter when multiplexing support is present and the parent device is an adapter, otherwise reporting absence.
